% 17.02.2023 [Physical Hearing/ Hybrid Hearing]

1. The present writ petitions have been filed with prayer for directions to the respondents to pay Special Rehabilitation Package to the petitioners in the same manner and on the same terms as has been paid to similarly situated villagers of Villages Pooth Khurd, Sultanpur, Karala and Kanjhawala,
whose land has also been acquired at the same time when the land of the Petitioners has been acquired.

2. It is the case of the petitioners that they are the co-sharers of the land of various Khasra numbers,
situated in Revenue Estate of Village Tikri Khud, Delhi.
3. A Notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 was issued showing intention to acquire the land of the various Khasra numbers of the village in question.
The Declaration under Section 6 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 was issued on 22.02.2007.
This was followed by Award dated 16.02.2009 bearing Award No.10 of 2008-09/DC/NW of Village Tikri Khurd.

4. It is the case of the petitioner that a Writ Petition being W.P.(C) No. 537/2010 was filed before Shri Ishwar Singh Bhardwaj & Ors vs Govt. Of N.C.T. Of Delhi Through Land ... on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116894035/
2 this Court for seeking payment of compensation amount and also the amount of Special Rehabilitation Package.

entities.text: Ishwar Singh Bhardwaj & Ors vs Govt. Of N.C.T. Of Delhi
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, no payment for Special Rehabilitation Package was made.

Thus, it is submitted that by judgment dated 27.09.2011 in W.P.(C) No. 537/2010, directions were given by this Court to the Revenue Authorities to offer payment of Special Rehabilitation Package to the various persons who were inhabitants of the village in question, in terms of the office order dated 01.10.2008 of the respondents.

5. It is submitted that since the judgment dated 27.09.2011 passed by this Court in W.P.(C) No.
537/2010 was not complied with, a Contempt petition being Contempt Case (Civil) No. 929/2011 titled as 'Ashwani Kumar Vs. Lal Singh and Another' and Contempt Case (Civil) No.201/2012 titled as "Rohtas Vs. Vijay Dev & Another"
came to be filed.

entities.text: Ashwani Kumar Vs. Lal Singh and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that the said Contempt Cases came to be disposed of with liberty to raise claims with respect to the difference of amounts payable to the petitioners herein.
6. It is submitted that Writ Petition (Civil) No. 8823/2017 was disposed of by this Court by judgment dated 18.08.2022.

By the said judgment, co-ordinate Bench of this Court had allowed the writ petitions, thereby directing the Authorities to make the payment of Special Rehabilitation Package in the same manner as has been made qua other aforesaid villages.

It is further submitted that this Court in the said judgment dated 18.08.2022 in W.P.(C) No. 8823/2017 has recorded a definite finding that there is discrimination qua village in question i.e. Village Tikri Khurd with regard to the calculation, which has been made qua other four villages, namely, Pooth Khurd,
Sultanpur, Karala and Kanjhawala.

7. Learned counsel for the petitioners further submits that a similar Writ Petition being W.P.(C) No.
1136/2023 was filed, in which notice has already been issued and the same is pending consideration before this Court on 29.05.2023.
8.
In view thereof, issue notice to the respondent.
9. Let reply be filed within four weeks.
Rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within two weeks thereafter.
10. List along with W.P.(C) No. 1136/2023 on 29.05.2023.
MINI PUSHKARNA, J FEBRUARY 17, 2023 PB Shri Ishwar Singh Bhardwaj & Ors vs Govt. Of N.C.T. Of Delhi Through Land ...
